title: Unhandled promise rejection in background.js:323 (chrome.tabs.onAttached → normalizeMeridianTab)
description:
Chrome's extension error panel reports an error at `background.js:323 (anonymous function)`. That line is the closing `});` of the async callback passed to `chrome.tabs.onAttached.addListener` (background.js:304-323).

Root cause: inside that listener, `await normalizeMeridianTab(tab)` is called at line 322. Inside `normalizeMeridianTab` (background.js:97-112):
- `tab = await chrome.tabs.update(tab.id, update);` (line 101) has NO try/catch guard.
- Immediately below it, `tab = await chrome.tabs.move(tab.id, { index: 0 });` (line 105) IS wrapped in try/catch with a "window or tab closed" comment — showing the pattern already exists but wasn't applied consistently to the update() call.

If the tab is closed, detached again, or its window is mid-teardown in the moment between `onAttached` firing and this update() call resolving (a real race during rapid tab attach/detach, e.g. dragging tabs between windows quickly), `chrome.tabs.update` rejects (e.g. "No tab with id: N" or "Tabs cannot be edited right now"). Since neither this call nor the `onAttached` listener itself catches it, it becomes an unhandled promise rejection — surfacing as the Chrome extension error at line 323.

Fix:
1. Wrap `chrome.tabs.update(tab.id, update)` at background.js:101 in a try/catch consistent with the `move()` call right below it (tab/window may be gone — fail gracefully, don't throw).
2. Audit `normalizeMeridianTab` as a whole and its callers (`ensureMeridianTabInWindow`, the `onAttached` listener, `protectMeridianTab`) for other unguarded `chrome.tabs.*` calls that could reject due to the same class of race condition (tab/window disappearing mid-flight) and add equivalent guards.
3. Mirror the fix into meridian-extension/background.js.
4. Verify no regression to the tab-management/dedup behavior recently fixed in other background.js tasks (second-window tab duplication, Meridian tab restoration) — this file has had several recent concurrent fixes, so re-run the full test suite and check for interaction effects.
label: Bug

activity.content:
## Completed

- Guarded `chrome.tabs.update` in `normalizeMeridianTab` so tab attach/detach races resolve without an unhandled rejection.
- Guarded window-scoped tab queries and creation, plus focus activation, when a tab or window disappears mid-flight.
- Mirrored all runtime changes into `meridian-extension/background.js`.
- Added lifecycle regressions covering rejected update, query, create, and activation operations.
- Preserved existing deduplication/restoration behavior; the concurrency, stale replacement, removal restoration, and packaged parity tests all pass.

Validation: `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` — 152 tests passed; `git diff --check` passed.
